((ll)costBoth * max<ll>(need1 , need2)) : (((ll)cost1 * need1) + ((ll)cost2 * need2));\n\n        return total;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-acquire-required-items","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1419}
